scope: Granny encoded knot/control expansion, upper-word float32 scale and quantized quaternion selectors. No interpolation, carrier or native rig policy.

transformProjection.scope: Matrix convention facts and independent oracle; existing Core composition/product kernels implement the projection, without copied LSLib matrix code.
transformProjection.convention: Native row-vector S*R*T becomes column-vector T*R*transpose(S). Presence flags select identity defaults before projection.
transformProjection.precision: Existing quaternion normalization; float32 T*R composition, finite affine product. Zero quaternion is reported; caller owns refusal. No canonical units/axes or engine evaluation claim.

limitations: D9I1 family is outside this profile; upstream format14 contains an uncertainty TODO, format12 is conservatively refused.
Expanded controls are not evaluated keyframes. Degree2/3 engine sampling needs independent qualification.
Format0 knots remain sample indices and require explicit native time mapping.

identityDimensionQualification.scope: DaIdentity.Dimension=0 is valid when the caller supplies an explicit vector/quaternion/matrix domain. Positive conflicting dimensions still refuse.
evidence: LSLib/Granny/Model/CurveData/DaIdentity.cs defines identity controls from the requested semantic getter
